design: paired 4-card baseline(A) vs PREP(B) qualification on the WHOLE-CARD lane, the 4 cards production does not presplit; n=4 is descriptive and the four strata collapse — see whole_card_pool_rule
fences: fuzzy TM hit is never exact-content reuse
go_rule: GO only if PREP loses at most one additional audited card AND improves wall time or total non-cache tokens by more than 10%; otherwise NO-GO
known_non_equivalences: production does not PRESPLIT these 4 cards (H2598 measured 4 whole / 44 presplit, and this manifest's presplit_keys is empty), but it does BATCH them: the generator packs them 2-per-agent-call, so production issues 2 calls where this rig issues 4 per arm. The prompt bytes are production's and the cards are un-split, but "whole-card lane" means un-split, NOT one-card-per-call — an earlier draft of this rig claimed the call shape was production's here, and the manifest refutes it. Both arms are affected identically, so the paired A-vs-B comparison is unharmed; absolute wall-clock and token figures are not production figures and must not be quoted as such.
what this buys is a verdict about the 8 %% lane only; the 92 %% lane is H2612.

n=4, not 8: the whole-card pool holds exactly 4 cards, so the sample is the POPULATION of this lane rather than a draw from it. There is no sampling error to quote and no strata to balance — both are properties of a census, not weaknesses to route around, but the loss of statistical power relative to n=8 is real and a receipt must not read as if it were an eight-card result.

whole-card cards are citation-light BY CONSTRUCTION (they fall under the presplit predicate's cite floor and sense budget), so this lane cannot exhibit the citation-dense failure mode at all. A clean result here is not evidence about dense cards.
manifest schema is pwg.headless_execution_manifest.v1 (unbound): a measurement rig, never a bulk execution path.
the manifest declares model claude-sonnet-5 as the LANE default; both arms explicitly request claude-opus-5 and the returned model is attested per call.

prep_delimiters.open: === PREP CONTEXT (advisory; non-promotable; TM writes forbidden) ===

exclusions: synthetic fixtures: any key whose stem starts with a SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES entry (the curated canary is a control, not a real card; H2591 requires eight REAL cards)

content duplicates: cards whose raw bytes hash identically are ONE card under two spellings (e.g. vyavasTA / vyavas_t_a). Keeping both would silently halve the sample — three cards masquerading as six. The lexicographically first key1 wins.
selection_rule.frozen: keys are sealed into plan.json before any call; a failed card is never replaced

metrics.content_sha256: sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")) — the dedupe key, not a stratifier

order: long_monster: bytes >= 12000 (prep_pack.MONSTER_BYTES); if fewer than 2 qualify, the 2 largest by bytes. Tie-break key1 ascending.
markup_heavy: of the remainder, the 2 highest placeholders. Tie-break key1 ascending.
polysemous: of the remainder, source_senses >= 6 (prep_pack.POLYSEMY_SENSE_FLOOR), the 2 highest source_senses; if fewer than 2 qualify, the 2 highest overall. Tie-break key1 ascending.
simple: of the remainder, the 2 smallest bytes among source_senses <= 2 and placeholders <= 2; if fewer than 2 qualify, the 2 smallest bytes overall. Tie-break key1 ascending.
selection_rule.pool: every key with both <key>.raw.txt and <key>.portrait.json in the pilot input dir

whole_card_pool_rule.census_not_sample: the whole-card pool holds exactly as many cards as the plan takes, so this is the POPULATION of the 8 % lane, not a draw from it. No stratification is possible or needed; the four strata of SELECTION_RULE collapse by construction.
exclusions: synthetic fixtures and content duplicates, on SELECTION_RULE's terms — the pool is the same 48 distinct real cards, only classified rather than ranked
every card production presplits: those go through the fragment lane, which H2612 qualifies separately
whole_card_pool_rule.frozen: keys are sealed into plan.json before any call; a failed card is never replaced
whole_card_pool_rule.known_bias: whole-card cards are citation-light by construction — that is WHY production takes them whole — so this lane cannot exhibit the citation-dense failure mode at all
whole_card_pool_rule.pool: every key production does NOT presplit, classified with production's own predicate gen_opt_harness2._presplit_hit at its own cite floor and sense budget — read from the module, never restated here
whole_card_pool_rule.unit: a UNIT is one whole card, called once per arm, exactly as the whole lane does
